title: Propagation failure in heterogeneous FitzHugh--Nagumo systems via coupled upper and lower solutions
summary: Traveling waves are fundamental objects in reaction--diffusion systems; however, spatial heterogeneities can distort or inhibit their propagation. Determining whether a given heterogeneity results in propagation failure remains challenging, particularly in systems with coupled components. In this paper, we present explicit constructions of stationary coupled upper and lower solutions tailored to specific heterogeneities for a one-dimensional FitzHugh--Nagumo system.
